1. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.62 of 2024 pending on the file of learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special Court under the POCSO Act, Nayagarh arising out of Nayagarh Sadar P.S. Case No.29 of 2023 for commission of offences punishable under Section 363/366/376(3)/376(2)(n)/109 of the IPC read with Section 6/17 of the POCSO Act.
